findings.issue: In AC-2 describe, EmailChannelDriver is constructed twice (once for registry key lookup, once as value) — both with a new FakeSmtpSender(). The second instance's FakeSmtpSender is unused for assertion since AC-2 only asserts enqueue counts. Dead construction in test fixture.
findings.suggestion: Reuse a single emailDriver instance for the AC-2 registry, or drop the second construction since AC-2 does not assert SMTP delivery.
